adapted_from: the evals.json shape of github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills skills/*/evals/evals.json at commit 1efedbc5148b54b2f0f6c6c9fe0be62e151c7fff (MIT; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
description: The filming workflow's example set (US-ME09, F5), in the marketingskills evals.json shape: each example's prompt, the output expected, its assertions, and its files. A deterministic assertion is checked by the unit tests (src/tests/test_filming_examples.py) against the synthetic kit in files/mandu, laid over the post-Draft example set's kit, and the synthetic footage inventory in files/footage.json; one that names what it needs runs only where the video tooling is installed, and is skipped with that reason elsewhere. A judged assertion waits for US-ME16's re-run on every Instructions change. An edit example's files are its candidate edit record and its post Draft, then the reference leg's edit record and Draft when it is an A/B pair leg; an asset example's file holds the facts measured of a rendered asset.

assertion_kinds.deterministic: check is one of: plan_is_one_item; plan_films, plan_reuses, plan_on_camera, plan_unplanned (days); plan_sittings (count); plan_quotes_formats; edit_passes; blocked_by (rule: a finding's rule); asset_blocked (says: words of the finding); asset_kept; renders and legs_differ_only_in_the_opening (needs: video tooling)
assertion_kinds.judged: text is a statement a reviewer, or a model at US-ME16, judges true or false of the agent's edit record and summary

evals.prompt: Plan the filming of window 1 from the kit.
evals.expected_output: One filming plan item: every calendar day with an Angle has a shot list read from its Angle's Format, the later leg of each A/B pair films nothing new, and the shots fall into one sitting per setup the shot lists state.

assertions.text: Nothing in the plan says more about a shot than its Angle's Format and the calendar do.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 1 (P01 / AB-1 leg A): the brief lists `window-1/d01-s1.mov`, 14.00s, for shot d01-s1, which may not be cut and runs in real time, and the Draft's beats end at 10s.
evals.expected_output: One segment: ten unbroken seconds of the one file, as recorded. It passes every check, and the launcher renders it as a 9:16 asset with the Draft's text drawn over it.

assertions.text: The agent chose its source range from the measured length alone, and said it could not see the footage.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 8 (P01 / AB-1 leg B), whose other leg, day 1, already has its video.
evals.expected_output: The same source ranges as day 1, from the first frame to the last: the legs share their footage, and only the Hook drawn over it differs.

assertions.text: The agent copied day 1's segments and changed nothing but the day.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 8; the candidate below starts its range a second later than day 1's.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks it: the leg differs from day 1's beyond the opening, so no asset is rendered and day 8 has no post.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 1; the candidate below drops two seconds from the middle of the recording.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks it, naming the no-cut rule and its source: shot d01-s1 may not be cut, and the record shows it as two source ranges.

assertions.text: A good edit record of an uncut shot is one segment.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 2 (P02 / AB-3 leg A), whose shot list has a founder-on-camera shot and a screen recording; the candidate below shows only the founder.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks it: shot d02-s2 has no footage in the edit, so there is no asset, and nothing is substituted for the shot.

assertions.text: When the brief lists no footage for a shot, the agent writes no edit record for the day and says which shot is missing.

evals.expected_output: The launcher does not keep it: by measurement it is not 9:16.
The launcher does not keep it: it is 9:16, and not the expected 1080x1920.

evals.prompt: A rendered asset measures 1080x1920 at 30 frames a second, as long as its edit record.
Write the edit record for day 1; the candidate below names a file in another folder by stepping out of the footage place.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks it: an edit record can name only a file the footage place holds, so nothing outside the Founder's footage can enter a video.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 1; the candidate below names a file by its full path elsewhere on the Mac.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks it the same way.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 1; the candidate below speeds the whole recording up to fit ten seconds.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks it: the shot list says real time, so the recording plays only at the speed it was recorded at.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 1; the candidate below runs twelve seconds.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks it: the Format gives ten seconds, and the Draft's beats end at ten.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 7 (P07), a timelapse of a whole five-minute session: the brief lists `window-1/d07-s1.mov`, 330.00s.
evals.expected_output: One segment at twenty times the recorded speed: a timelapse is not real time, so its shot list lets it run faster. It passes.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 2 (P02 / AB-3 leg A), a pair whose opening the kit marks as re-cut: leg A's opening take, the screen recording, then the closing line.
evals.expected_output: Three segments, with leg A's own take in the opening. It passes.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 9 (P02 / AB-3 leg B), whose other leg, day 2, already has its video.
evals.expected_output: Leg B's own take in the opening, then the same source ranges as day 2. It passes: the legs differ only in the opening.

assertions.text: The agent used the take named for leg B in the opening and copied every later segment from day 2.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 9; the candidate below also starts the screen recording two seconds later than day 2's.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks it: the legs' source ranges differ after the re-cut opening.

evals.prompt: Write the edit record for day 9; the candidate below opens on the take named for leg A.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks it: a take named for one leg is that leg's opening.
